title: Booking a Badminton Class
context: A caller phones a leisure centre to book a place in a community badminton class.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Good morning, Greenfield Leisure Centre. How can I help you?

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Oh, hello. I saw a poster in the supermarket about your evening sports classes, and I'd like to book a place, please.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Of course, no problem at all. I can do that for you over the phone right now. First, could I take a few details? What's your name, please?

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Yes, it's Anna Marsden.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Could you spell the surname for me?

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Sure. It's M-A-R-S-D-E-N. Marsden.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: M-A-R-S-D-E-N. Lovely, thank you. And a contact phone number?

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: It's my mobile. The number is 07700 900426.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Let me just read that back. 07700 900426.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: That's right.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Great. Now, which class were you interested in? We run several in the evenings.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Well, I was thinking about tennis at first, but a friend told me the beginners' badminton class is really friendly, so I'd like to join that one.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: The beginners' badminton class. Good choice. It's one of our most popular classes, and there are still a couple of places left this term, so you're just in time.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: And which evening is it on? The poster said Tuesday, I think.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: It used to be on Tuesday, yes, but the timetable changed last month... actually, make that Thursday. It's on Thursday evenings now.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Thursday. Okay, that's even better for me.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Perfect. The class starts at 6.30 pm and runs for an hour and a half, so you finish at eight.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: 6.30 pm. Fine. And how much does it cost?

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: If you pay week by week it's 12 pounds a session, but most people pay monthly, which works out much cheaper. The monthly fee is 42 pounds.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: 42 pounds a month? Yes, I'll do that. That's a good saving over the term.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: It is, definitely. Now, one thing people always ask about is equipment. You don't need to buy anything for the first few weeks. We lend out rackets free of charge, and the shuttlecocks are provided by the coach.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Oh, that's helpful. Is there anything I do need to bring?

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Just wear comfortable sports clothes and trainers, and please bring a water bottle. The hall gets quite warm, and we don't sell drinks in the evening.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: A water bottle. Got it. And how do I pay the monthly fee? Can I pay cash at reception?

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: We used to take cash, but not any more, I'm afraid. You could pay by card when you come in, but honestly the easiest way is by bank transfer. We email you the details and the payment goes out automatically each month.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Okay, I'll set up the bank transfer, then. That sounds simplest.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Lovely. I'll send the email this afternoon. Now, do you know how to find us? The address is 14 Bridge Road, just past the public library on the corner.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Yes, I think I know the building. I usually come into town by bus, but I might drive on class nights. Is there parking?

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: There is, but be careful. The main car park at the front is for the swimming pool only in the evenings, and you can't park on Mill Street because of the new bus lane. So drivers for the classes should use the small car park behind the sports hall.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Behind the sports hall. Fine, I'll remember that.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: One last thing. On your first evening, don't go straight into the hall. Come to reception first, so we can print your membership card and take a quick photo.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Okay, so I go to reception first, and then join the class.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: Exactly. The coach, Danny, will meet you there and take you through. You're all booked in for this Thursday.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Wonderful. Thanks so much for your help.

script.speaker: Receptionist
script.text: You're very welcome, Anna. See you on Thursday. Bye now.

script.speaker: Caller
script.text: Bye.
